candidates.requirement: Exercise the new dump depth check with a supported json_t nested beyond JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH.
candidates.target_route: The entry passes a loaded json_t to json_dumps or json_dump_callback. A constructed nested array passed to either dump operation reaches the changed check.
candidates.failure_condition: parse_value rejects nesting beyond JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH. Accepted trees are dumped from depth zero, so their deepest value remains below the new do_dump threshold.
candidates.alternative_paths: Both dump modes use json_dump_callback and the same do_dump path. The complete entry only obtains dump objects through json_loadb and never constructs or extends one.
